qualification: device-level host fuzzing of the pinned, patched sources in scratch copies; no VM booted; debug builds with overflow checks; not coverage-guided; not an audit

findings.origin: upstream code, untouched by local patches
findings.trigger: guest packet src_port=<host-listened port>, dst_port=620 with stream RESPONSE, RST, RW or CREDIT_UPDATE, or dgram RW; TSI disabled
findings.observed: UnixAcceptorProxy unreachable!() panics on the caller; the poisoned proxy lock then panics the muxer thread; the device serves no new connection
findings.control: REQUEST, SHUTDOWN and unknown ops leave it healthy
findings.exposure: the experimental helper registers its ports with listen=true
findings.scope: availability of that VM's helper; no escape or cross-VM effect shown
